name: Espírito Santo
summary: Three horizontal bands of blue, white and pink, with 'TRABALHA E CONFIA' ('Work and trust') on the white band. One of very few flags to use pink.
origin: Governor Jerônimo Monteiro created the flag in 1908; blue, white and pink became state colours in 1909. It was adopted by Decree 16.618 on 24 April 1947. A 1989 campaign to change the pink to red was rejected.

colors.name: Blue
colors.meaning: Harmony; the mantle of Our Lady of Victory.

colors.name: Pink
colors.meaning: Happiness; the mantle of Our Lady of Victory.

symbols.name: Motto
symbols.meaning: From Saint Ignatius of Loyola: work as if all depended on you, trust as if all depended on God.

facts: Its colours come from the mantle of Our Lady of Victory, patron of the capital Vitória.
Residents resisted a 1989 attempt to swap the pink for red.
clues: Blue, white and pink bands with a motto about work and trust.
One of very few flags with pink.
Its motto comes from the founder of the Jesuits.
